retrievalProfile.description: A close-up portrait of a man in western attire featuring a wide-brimmed cowboy hat and plaid shirt, set against a textured stone background with layered serif and script typography.
triggerTerms: western portrait with serif and script text
cowboy hat portrait with textured background

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a man looking off-camera, wearing a light-colored cowboy hat and a blue-and-white plaid shirt. The background is a blurred, earthy-toned stone wall. The composition is anchored by large, bold serif text at the bottom and a smaller script word above it.
coreVisualRelationships: The light cowboy hat creates a bright horizontal band that frames the subject's face.
The blue plaid shirt provides a cool-toned base for the warm-toned skin and background.
The large red-toned serif text at the bottom provides a heavy visual foundation.
The textured stone background adds organic depth without distracting from the subject.
coreInvariants: Subject must wear a wide-brimmed western cowboy hat.
Subject must be looking away from the camera in a three-quarter profile.
Background must be a textured, out-of-focus natural surface like stone or wood.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold serif text at the bottom edge of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the right, then drops down to the script text and finally the large serif name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, with the background filled by textured stone and the foreground by the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blues and whites from the plaid shirt.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and tans from the skin, mustache, and stone background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red and navy blue used in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Naturalistic saturation with high value in the hat and shirt highlights, contrasted by deep shadows in the background texture.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and denim-inspired blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic Roman serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses high-contrast serifs with sharp terminals.
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected script with a slight tilt.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The primary serif text features a subtle drop shadow to separate it from the plaid pattern.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a formal, heavy serif with a casual, light script.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows for legibility over busy patterns

preserve: Serif classification for the main name

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman Bold or Georgia
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic, authoritative serif look required for the main name.
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a mustache wearing a white cowboy hat and a blue plaid shirt, looking to the side against a blurred stone wall background. Leave the bottom third of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large name in bold red serif font with a black drop shadow at the bottom. Above the right side of the name, add a smaller title in navy blue script font.

verificationChecks: Is the cowboy hat clearly visible and well-lit?
Is the main text a bold serif with a drop shadow?
Is the secondary text a contrasting script font?
Is the background a textured, natural surface?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Legible text overlay on a patterned shirt

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the drop shadow makes the red text pop against the blue plaid.
Verify the script text is legible despite its smaller size.
Confirm the subject's gaze creates a sense of depth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Western Portrait + Textured Background + (Bold Serif + Casual Script) Typography Overlay
